story.lead: I am a registered nurse and backend developer with a deep interest in thoughtful technology and dependable digital support.
paragraphs: Clinical work has taught me to think critically, communicate clearly, and stay precise under pressure. Those same standards guide how I build software, support customers, organize work, and collaborate with others.

My experience includes backend development, medical virtual assistance, customer service, search engine optimization, and digital marketing. I am especially interested in work that combines healthcare insight with useful, well-managed digital services.
story.quote: Whether I am working in care, code, or client support, the goal is the same: solve real problems thoughtfully and reliably.
